title: Sunday · forty thousand
logline: The second Sunday of the arc: the beach from the bluff, and on it, to the horizon, stick figures. Forty thousand of them, all facing the drift log. On the log, from behind, two-thirds size: Wood. The dog, normal.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach from the bluff. The sand covered to the horizon with stick figures, thousands, a texture, all facing one point. The sea beyond them, indifferent.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor with a dense ink texture of thousands of tiny crude stick figures covering a beach to the horizon all facing one direction, the sea beyond, no words
image.notes: Draw the figures as texture, not individuals; the number is the point.

panels.name: Forty thousand

panels.composition: Tier 2: the drift log. Wood on it from behind at two-thirds size, the dog beside him at full size. The front row of stick figures, huge by comparison, holding signs: LOL. ROFL. MORE.

image.prompt: watercolor, a small man seen from behind on a drift log beside a normal-sized dog, a front row of crude stick figures towering over them holding signs, no words
image.notes: Letter after: LOL · ROFL · MORE. Wood at two-thirds, the dog at full.

panels.name: Front row

panels.composition: Tier 3: the sea. Just the sea. The one thing on the page not looking at him.

image.prompt: over-wet watercolor of a gray sea with small waves and nothing else, no words

panels.name: The sea

art.palette: limited; Sundays in watercolor, good now
art.paper: bristol; the browser; from 2008 coastal newsprint a week behind

notes: Forty thousand on the beach. Two-thirds on the log. The sea doesn't look.
